content: OpenRefine reconciliation UI: each candidate match shows an identifier, human-readable name, type, and numeric matching score; a facet lets you filter/browse cells by best-candidate score; confidently-matched cells render as a distinct visual state (blue link) so the eye is drawn only to unmatched/low-confidence cells; single tick accepts one cell's match, double tick bulk-accepts identical matches across the column. This single-cell vs bulk-accept action is a reusable UI pattern for a review screen.
